A3: Simplified Chinese for China profile and Traditional Chinese for Taiwan profile separately authored. Language is not ownership. A5: N/A FDI scope; no domestic supplier-entry/qualification/audit-pass promise.
A6: Concrete questions about handoff point/product/lot/records and responsibility. Neutral illustrative trays, blank sheets and abstract nodes; no actual IDs, values, technical UI or customer facility. A5 scene compact with two plain tiles, no document glyph.
A7: Cold handoff trigger -> shared records/confirmers -> one agreed handoff point -> record mismatch clarification -> both-side confirmation -> shared coordination discussion -> Vietnam consulting/implementation -> provider role -> China chip-design case -> qualitative outsourcing pain/integrated solution -> reader. No persona/geography/solution-causality switch.
brand_role: Official mark once in header; category/sequence functional. Digiwin in source is publisher/service attribution, legal customer name separate. No customer mark, staff portrait or facility authenticity.
advertiser_voice: Direct we/our team voice in both scripts. Prospective consultation, not testimonial or invented customer outcome. Taiwan context, Vietnam service and China case remain distinct.
reader: Localized overview of same named China case with qualitative outsourcing challenges/integrated solution and same F3 handoff questions. Exact legal name original Simplified; Hant source-language disclosure. Localized return to handoff journey.
